response.final_text:
I proposed CLOSE_FP for A-261110-0006 with 0.6 confidence. It is only a proposal, and a human analyst decides.

Three facts drove it:
1. The trader bought 1087 by market order at 15:56:29, then sold exactly 1087 by market order at 15:56:49. The sale filled at 9994–9992 against a buy at 10000–10002. Price moved –3 ticks, with no reversion after the cancel. The round trip was –7.84 ticks. That reads as a position closed at a loss, so feature (b), a benefit from the opposite-side trade, is absent.
2. There is no sign of a pattern. There were no repetitions in the session, no prior alerts on this trader, and the order-to-trade ratio was 0.75. There was no news or risk event, and the other explanations on the list were ruled out. Momentum trader stopped out is the one I recorded as supported.
3. The three BUY limits (3 × 3913, about 4.8× depth in total, 6 ticks from the touch) had no fills. They were all cancelled 600 ms after the sale, so their intent is not proven.

What would change my mind: evidence that the sale did not close the earlier buy, or that the price fell because of the resting bids and then rebounded after they were cancelled. Similar cycles on other days would also change it.
